fields.Name: Model Predictions View Gate
fields.Description: The view gate of Predictive Studio predictions (D-058). Attached to every role's read permission on MJ: Feature Values and MJ: Latest Feature Values: a Pipeline or Human value stays visible to every reader, and a model prediction (Source Model) is visible only to a user who holds its scoring binding's view authorization, as vwUserHeldAuthorizations states MJ's authorization rule. A binding with no view authorization is visible to no user (fail closed).
fields.FilterText: Source <> 'Model' OR MLModelScoringBindingID IN (SELECT b.ID FROM __mj.MLModelScoringBinding b JOIN __mj.vwUserHeldAuthorizations a ON a.AuthorizationID = b.ViewAuthorizationID WHERE a.UserID = '{{UserID}}')
